title: Get Ready for an Amazing Alpaca Walking Adventure at Woodlands Manor Farm
author: ruth
excerpt: Visit Woodlands Manor Farm to enjoy a peaceful and unique experience with our lovely alpacas Napoleon, Erebus, and Henry.
contentHtml:
Get Ready for an Amazing Alpaca Walking Adventure at Woodlands Manor Farm

If you’re looking for an unforgettable holiday experience, Woodlands Manor Farm in Cornwall has you covered. Alongside our charming self-catering holiday cottages and luxury yurts, our idyllic retreat is home to three delightful alpacas, Napoleon, Erebus, and Henry, who live with us here on the farm. Visiting our fuzzy friends will add a whole new level of charm to your stay, and best of all, we hope to offer a unique alpaca walking experience for our guests this summer, giving you the chance to get up close and personal.

Alpaca trekking has become popular in recent years, and it’s not hard to see why. These gentle and curious creatures have an irresistible charm that appeals to people of all ages. When you walk side by side with these friendly animals, you’ll forge a unique bond that connects you with nature in a way you’ve never experienced before.

But that’s not all. Alpaca walking is like therapy for the soul. Spending time with alpacas has been known to reduce stress, anxiety, and even lower blood pressure. Just being around these lovely creatures creates a calm atmosphere where you can simply relax and find solace in the simplicity of nature. It’s an opportunity to escape the fast-paced modern world and embrace the peacefulness of the countryside.

As well as this, alpaca walking is a great way to get some exercise too. While strolling alongside these graceful animals, you’ll be able to soak up the beauty of Cornwall’s countryside at a leisurely pace. It’s the ultimate outdoor activity that lets you enjoy the great outdoors and take in the stunning scenery without any pressure or rush.

Now, here’s the best part: alpaca walking is a fantastic adventure for families, couples, or even solo travellers. Our alpacas are super friendly and love hanging out with people. They’re so gentle that even the little ones can join in on the fun! It’s an incredible opportunity for families to create lasting memories together and embark on a truly unique adventure.

If you’re looking for a relaxing retreat, a chance to reconnect with nature, or a one-of-a-kind family adventure, alpaca walking at Woodlands Manor Farm is sure to tick all the boxes. And our team is always ready to share fascinating insights into the behaviour and characteristics of our alpacas. So, not only is it an adventure, but it’s also an educational experience!

Don’t miss out on the magic of alpaca walking! Plan your visit to Woodlands Manor Farm and let the delightful company of Napoleon, Erebus, and Henry steal your heart and lift your spirits. title: Hit the Waves at One of the Local Surf Schools
author: ruth
excerpt: If you are seeking adventure and excitement during your stay at Woodlands Manor Farm, the nearby coastal town of Bude provides the ideal spot for surfing.
contentHtml:
Hit the Waves at One of the Local Surf Schools

Located in the beautiful countryside of North Cornwall, our luxury holiday cottages and lovely yurts offer an idyllic holiday destination for those seeking peace and tranquillity. However, for those seeking adventure and excitement, the nearby coastal town of Bude provides the ideal spot for surfing.

Bude’s location on the coast means that it is exposed to some of the best waves in the UK. This makes it a popular destination for surfers from all over the world. With Summerleaze Beach, Crooklets Beach and Widemouth Bay all in close proximity, you have plenty of fantastic options to choose from when you fancy hitting the waves. The town itself has a number of excellent surf schools, which offer lessons and equipment hire for all levels of surfers.

For those staying at Woodlands Manor Farm, there are several surf schools that we recommend. Here are some of the local surf schools that we know offer fantastic experiences:

Saltwater Safari

Great for beginners and experienced surfers alike, Saltwater Safari can cater to individuals, couples and small groups with their fantastic lessons that focus on teaching you new skills and equipping you with valuable knowledge about surfing and the sea itself.

Big Blue Surf School

With over 20 years of experience in teaching people to surf on Summerleaze Beach, you can rest assured that you will be in good hands with Big Blue Surf School. Great for groups of friends and family, they can also cater for disabled and neurodiverse surfers.

MLH Surf Coaching

Run by professional surfer Miles Lee-Hargreaves, MLH Surf Coaching specialises in one to one and private group lessons. Miles has a passion for developing younger surfers and runs the Elite Junior Development Squad, but thanks to his expert experience Miles is fantastic with surfers of all levels of ability.

Freewave Surf Academy

Offering individual and small group sessions at both Widemouth Bay and Summerleaze Beach, the team of local instructors at Freewave Surf Academy delivers a truly first-rate surfing experience. From complete beginners to seasoned surfers looking to improve their skills, all are welcome.

Enjoy a Fantastic Surfing Experience During your Stay at Woodlands Manor Farm. Whether you’re a serious surfer or just looking for a fun family day out, Bude and the surrounding areas have some great spots for surfing with plenty of passionate and knowledgeable instructors available to provide an unforgettable experience. Whichever local surf school you choose, we’re confident you’ll have an incredible time tackling some of the best waves the UK has to offer.

Our self catering yurts and holiday cottages are located a short distance from Bude and its lovely beaches, offering the perfect accommodation if you’re planning to hit the waves during your stay. If you’re unsure which local surf school will be most suited to you and your group, simply visit the farm and Ruth and Andy will happily offer advice and guidance.

title: Enjoy Sunbathing, Surfing or a Leisurely Stroll at one of our Local Beaches
author: ruth
excerpt: We are so privileged to have some truly beautiful beaches nearby. Whether you fancy a relaxed walk, a spot of surfing or a day sunbathing on the sand, we'll help you find the perfect beach.
contentHtml:
Enjoy Sunbathing, Surfing or a Leisurely Stroll at one of our Local Beaches

Bude Sea Pool at Summerleaze Beach – 📷 Visit Cornwall

Who doesn’t love a day at the beach? Whether you’re sunbathing, taking a dip in the sea, building a sand castle, having a picnic, taking a romantic stroll or anything else, having a beach nearby is always fantastic. At Woodlands Manor Farm it’s fair to say that we are absolutely spoiled by choice when it comes to local beaches! With each one offering something a little different, you will definitely find the perfect beach to enjoy your chosen activity.

If you’re looking for a nice relaxing stay in a comfortable farm cottage or in search of the perfect spot for some glamping near the beach, Woodlands Manor Farm is the perfect location. Read on for our guide to each of the local beaches you can visit during your stay with us.

Duckpool

Duckpool Beach – 📷 National Trust

Duckpool is the closest beach to our luxury holiday cottages and you can drive there in under 10 minutes. This remote beach enjoys some amazing surroundings, including many rock pools and the 100 metre high Steeple Point Cliff which is a truly imposing feature.

Unfortunately, Duckpool isn’t suitable for swimming and many parts may be too rocky for a comfortable seaside picnic, but the scenery is beautiful. If you fancy a coastal walk you can head south to nearby Sandymouth beach or travel north to visit Hawker’s Hut and enjoy the best cream tea and pastries around at the Rectory Farm Tearooms – so good it was featured on The Hairy Bikers Comfort Food on the BBC!

Duckpool Beach

Duckpool Beach

Sandymouth

Sandymouth Beach – 📷 National Trust

This beach really comes alive when the tide is out. Sandymouth is popular with families and those just looking for a nice day out at the beach, as well as being a well-known surfing spot. With the fantastic Sandymouth beach cafe and public toilets available, it has everything you’ll need if you want to spend the whole day there. Lifeguard cover during the summer months means you can swim safely. Whether you’re there to relax, watch the surfers or have a swim, make sure you don’t miss the stunning waterfall!

Sandymouth Beach

Sandymouth Beach Cafe

Sandymouth Beach

Northcott Mouth

Northcott Mouth Beach – 📷 National Trust

 Northcott Mouth is a sandy cove with rugged charm, and as the tide goes out a sandy beach and rock pools are revealed. It’s the ideal spot for exploring and enjoying some truly beautiful surroundings. During low tide, keep your eyes peeled for the wreck of the SS Belem! No trip to Northcott Mouth is complete without visiting The Rustic Tea Garden for some delicious food and drinks while taking in the view.

Northcott Mouth

Northcott Beach

Northcott Beach

Summerleaze

Summerleaze Beach – 📷 Visit Bude

Just a few minutes walk from Bude town centre, Summerleaze is an incredible beach with a huge number of activities available. The beach itself is stunning and the backdrop of colourful beach huts is utterly delightful. From simply relaxing to surfing, kayaking and fishing, there is truly something for everyone at Summerleaze. One of the most popular attractions is the Bude Sea Pool located at the foot of the cliffs. This fascinating feature is completely free of charge, so there’s no reason not to get your swimsuit on and dive in! If you’re peckish there are plenty of options when it comes to food and drink. Life’s a Beach and The Barge are local favourites that you can’t go wrong with!

Summerleaze Beach Sea View

Summerleaze Beach in Summer

Summerleaze Beach Huts

Crooklets

Crooklets Beach – 📷 Visit Cornwall

Enjoy golden sand and rock pools as far as the eye can see at Crooklets. This picturesque beach is just a short walk from Summerleaze – you can actually walk directly from one to the other during low tide – and offers the perfect setting for catching some rays on those sunny summer days. Crooklets also enjoys a number of fantastic facilities nearby including play area, skate park, amusements and pubs. If you’re not a fan of sand, there is still plenty for you to do here. You won’t go hungry either, as Crooklets Beach Cafe and Rosie’s Kitchen both offer a delectable range of food and drinks – particularly the pizza at Rosie’s!

Crooklets Beach

Crooklets Beach, aerial view

Widemouth Bay

Widemouth Bay Beach – 📷 Visit Cornwall

Three miles south of Bude, Widemouth Bay is a large beach that is particularly popular with surfers. Whether you’re already a pro surfer or have never set foot on a board before, the conditions are suitable for surfers of all abilities. But a desire to hit the waves isn’t required to enjoy this beach. Take your blanket and windbreak or go exploring the rock pools, this gorgeous bay caters to all types of beachgoer. After working up an appetite you can visit Widemouth Bay Cafe or Beach House for a bite to eat. The Times listed Beach House as one of the top 20 beachside bars and restaurants in the UK, so it’s definitely not one to miss!

Whether you bring your surfboard or picnic basket you will have a fantastic time in these spectacular surroundings. title: Our Brand New Yurts are now Open!
author: ruth
excerpt: Our new Yurts are the perfect location for a relaxing glamping getaway. Enjoy the perfect balance of luxury and the stunning outdoors at Woodlands Manor Farm.
contentHtml:
Our Brand New Yurts are now Open!

Our two fantastic new yurts are officially open to guests and we couldn’t be more excited! Glamping has been growing in popularity over the past few years, with many holidaymakers having a desire to experience nature but still enjoy glamorous accommodation, so we knew the addition of yurts to our estate would go down an absolute treat with our visitors. Budhyn (the Cornish word for meadow) and Fenton (Cornish for spring) are spacious and comfortable, offering a luxurious stay with the stunning surroundings of Cornwall’s natural beauty situated right outside the door.

What is a Yurt?

The question we’re sure many of you will be asking yourselves right now! A yurt is a traditional type of tent originating in Central Asia. These unique structures were created to provide a stable and comfortable home that could also be easily unassembled and moved in order to suit the typically nomadic lifestyles of their inhabitants. Constructed from wood or bamboo and covered with animal skins or felt, yurts have been offering warmth, protection from the elements and a place to call home for thousands of years.

Authenticity and Luxury Under One Roof

Fortunately, you don’t have to travel to Central Asia to enjoy an authentic yurt – we can offer that experience right here at Woodlands Manor Farm. Visit us for your glamping getaway and have the pleasure of staying in one of our stunning yurts, sourced directly from Mongolia courtesy of the wonderful team at Kents of Cornwall. They are created using Mongolian larch wood and 100% natural Mongolian yak & sheep wool, allowing you to enjoy a genuine yurt experience in the serene surroundings of the Cornwall countryside.

Our yurts may well be authentic but that doesn’t mean you won’t be able to indulge in some modern luxuries. Both Budhyn and Fenton feature a super king-sized bed and two single beds with extra comfortable linen, soft, fluffy towels and their own shower room with WC. Their kitchens are kitted out with all of the appliances and accessories you’ll need to prepare delicious meals for you and your fellow guests, as well as plenty of seating and space for both indoor and outdoor dining.

Thanks to our picturesque location you will feel at one with nature but the complimentary wifi and convenient charging points will ensure you don’t run out of data or battery, letting you stay up to date with the rest of the world – only if you choose to, of course!Adventure and Exploration throughout the Local Area

You may be tempted to spend as much time as possible in the comfy confines of the yurt, but there is also so much to do nearby that you won’t want to miss out on. We are a short distance from some absolutely lovely locations. There are a number of gorgeous beaches close by, including Summerleaze, featuring an amazing sea pool, as well as the beautiful National Trust beaches Sandymouth and Duckpool. If you’re a nature lover and want to see more than just beaches, the very popular South West Coast Path is only 2 miles away, as is the wonderful Coombe Valley. As well as the scenic spots, there are many charming villages and towns within 10 miles or so that would be sure to give you a warm welcome.

If you prefer not to venture too far then you are always free to take a stroll around the peaceful and pleasant surroundings of our gardens, fields and woodlands. Don’t forget that residents of our yurts also have full access to the Woodlands Manor Farm facilities including heated indoor pool, games room, playground and more.

Glamping in Cornwall has Never Been More Luxurious

If you are planning a glamping in North Cornwall our luxury accommodation offers relaxation and excitement in equal measure. Unwind in the comfort of our authentic yurts or head out into the beautiful Cornwall and Devon countryside – whatever you choose to do Woodlands Manor Farm is the perfect location.
